'''Linear converters''' were [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts. The [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[AG-37]] visited [[Ania Solo]]'s [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junkyard]] in the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]] in [[138 ABY]] to procure a linear converter. Shortly later, Ania's junkyard was attacked by the rogue [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Wredd]], who was masquerading as the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Yalta Val]].
